title: Taskelith contract breaking-change declarations
description: packages/contracts/breaking-changes.json: per contract document and per version that declared breaking changes, the reason, the exact changes make contract-compatibility computes, and the behavior changes it cannot compute. Entries of earlier versions stay as history. make contract-compatibility also checks the paths, the versions, and the order.

path.description: A contract document path of CONTRACT_DOCUMENTS in scripts/generate-contracts.ts.

version.description: The info.version that declared the changes, a semantic version.

reason.description: A short English reason for the breaking changes.

breakingChanges.description: The changes as the check reports them, sorted by UTF-16 code units and unique; empty only beside behaviorChanges.

behaviorChanges.description: Breaks of behavior without a schema change, such as a request that succeeded and is now refused, which the check cannot report.
